meta.title: OpenScreenShot vs GoFullPage vs FullPage Capture
meta.description: A factual comparison of the three full page screenshot extensions: store status, open source, standing site access, one-click capture, free annotation, PDF, and tab recording.

label: Compare
heading: OpenScreenShot vs GoFullPage vs FullPage Capture
lead: GoFullPage was removed from the Chrome Web Store in August 2026. OpenScreenShot is the open-source full page screenshot you can actually audit. FullPage Capture is a closed extension that says local while asking for access to every website.
asOf: Facts as of 31 Aug 2026. GoFullPage's private fork since 2018 is from its own FAQ.

rows.gfp: Ancestor repo only; privately forked since 2018
Old GitHub, not the shipping binary
